title: perfect size
text: perfect size. these are the perfect size for individual size cakes or breads. I make low carb.low sugar items in these and since they don't rise a lot, these are perfect for them..they are the size of those little cocktail rye breads. and nothing sticks to them and they clean so easy.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Recipe Right Non-Stick Mini Loaf Pan Set, 3-Piece, Steel
features: READY, SET, BAKE: Love to bake bread? This convenient set of three Wilton mini loaf pans maximizes your oven space and minimizes baking time. These bread pans are great for pound cakes, cornbread or homemade breads.

DURABILITY: These Wilton bread pans are constructed from heavy-gauge steel for even heating that gives a perfectly browned finish to your baked goods. The bread pans' wide handles are suitable for gripping with oven mitts.
NON- STICK: Durable premium non-stick coating on our loaf pans allows your food to slide or pop out easily, making cleanup almost effortless. Non-stick bakeware sets are a must-have for busy cooks.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Dishwasher safe; however for best results, wash these Wilton bread pans in warm, soapy water before first and after each use
INCLUDES: 3 mini loaf pans, dimensions: 5.75 x 3 in. (14.6 x 7.62 cm). Limited 10 year warranty
